name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.0: Custom skill registration via /superskillret:add (+ list, remove). User-pool index is kept separate from the system index so user skills survive upgrades. v0.1.1: per-session dedup + auto-bootstrap.
